data.name: Abrar
data.gender_notes: Abrar is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Abrar is a noble name of Arabic origin meaning 'righteous ones' or 'the pious'. It refers to individuals of strong moral character and deep spiritual values, often praised in the Quran. The name Abrar carries the meaning “Pious, Righteous, Virtuous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Abrar usually hope their child will grow to embody pious, righteous, virtuous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the pure-hearted believers who follow truth, justice, and kindness — those closest to divine pleasure.
data.etymology: Abrar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pious, Righteous, Virtuous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abrar total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: عبرار
in_arabic.long_meaning: العبرار: الأشخاص الذين يتمتعون بالعدالة والصلاح والخير، فهم من يحيا وفقا للقانون الشرعي، ويحافظون على الصدق في كلماتهم، ويقومون بالخير والبر في أعمالهم، ويحافظون على المحافظة على الصدق والخير في كل شيء.

in_urdu.name: عبرار
in_urdu.long_meaning: عبرار وہ لوگ ہوتے ہیں جو انصاف کے ساتھ زندگی بیتاتے ہیں، انہیں اللہ تعالیٰ کے قانون کی پیروی کرنے میں شرف حاصل ہوتا ہے، ان کی باتوں میں سچائی ہوتی ہے، ان کے اعمال میں خیر و برکت ہوتی ہے، انہیں ہر طرح سے سچائی اور خیر کا خیر مقدم کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अब्रार
in_hindi.long_meaning: अब्रार वे लोग होते हैं जो न्यायपूर्ण जीवन जीते हैं, जिनकी बातें सच्ची होती हैं, जो अच्छे काम करते हैं, जो ہر طرح سے سچائی اور خیر کا خیر مقدم کیا جातا ہے۔

in_pashto.name: عبرار
in_pashto.long_meaning: عبرار داګي کسان دي چې د نېټۍ په مخه ژوند کوي، هغه چې په راستي ژوند کوي، هغه چې ښه کسان دي، هغه چې د نېټۍ په مخه کار کوي، هغه چې ښه کسان دي، د نېټۍ په مخه کار کوي، هغه چې ښه کسان دي.

in_english.name: Abrar
in_english.long_meaning: Abrar refers to individuals who live a life of righteousness, honesty, and truthfulness. They are those who adhere to the laws of Allah and act upon them with integrity. In Islamic tradition, abrar signifies those who possess the qualities of justice, compassion, and kindness, and who strive to do good deeds in all aspects of their lives.
